summary: Probably John's 4th-great-grand-aunt by marriage; the widow 'Hulda Pringle' of the 1850 census.
bio: Huldah Ives was born in New York about 1804. In the 1850 Plymouth Twp census (14 Sep 1850, dwelling 942/family 962, two doors from James Pringle's household): Hulda Pringle 46, F, $600, b. New York; Orange Pringle 23, teamster, PA; Ransom 21; 'Caturah' 17; Jane 14; Lucinda 10; Sarah 6; Lucy Ives 87, F (marked insane - probably her mother); Philip Minchart 26, carpenter. Her daughter Hannah J. married engineer George Bisher on 1 Jan 1856. Her will: Plymouth Boro., 1887, vol. J p.499. Joshua Lamoreaux (Martha's brother) married a Martha Ives, possibly her kin (speculative).
sources: 1850 US census, Plymouth Twp, Luzerne Co., PA, enumerated 14 Sep 1850 by A. Atherton, Ass't Marshal, page 140/141 (stamp 71), NARA M432; dwelling 942 / family 962 (Hulda Pringle household); FamilySearch record attached to tree person Andrew Pringle 1836-1900, FamilySearch ID KG4S-XMF (screenshot IMG_7813)
